## TargetBuildReport.installsAuthoredSource property

True iff the target installs skills by scanning the authored source (Vercel Skills), so no generated directory can stand in for it and a failed build cannot withhold the plugin from it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
installsAuthoredSource: boolean;
```
